Hi Tom / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick exec-level recap from our call and proposed next steps so your procurement and legal teams can see the path forward.

Summary of what we heard (pain & business outcomes):
- Current pain: slow, inconsistent latency on in-house LLM serving; high per-token cost and spikes during peaks.
- Business outcome: reduce inference unit cost by ~40% while hitting 99.9% uptime for patient-facing features.
- Risk: data residency + PHI handling for certain workflows — must pass security review and KMS controls.

What we proposed today (high level):
- Redwood Dedicated with pinning for critical models + autoscale for peak daytime traffic.
- Hybrid private deployment option for PHI workloads (VPC + KMS) to meet audit/compliance needs.
- Performance/quantization profile that targets 40% cost reduction with <10% quality delta.

Procurement path & timing (from your comments):
- Security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence — expect review by AuroraMed SecOps next 2 weeks.
- Procurement/contracting: Aisha to coordinate with legal; typical AuroraMed procurement window ~6–10 weeks.
- Exec approval required: Tom (sponsor) to flag enablement in next leadership procurement sync.

Open items / asks: 
1) Tom: request an intro to Procurement/Law (or confirm point of contact) so we can send an initial SOW and contract template.
2) AuroraMed SecOps: we will provide SOC2 summary + high-level architecture doc for review (attached).
3) Scheduling: technical deep-dive with Rishi (SE) + Neha (Security) — proposed windows below.

Proposed next steps (actionable):
- I will send an initial SOW + proposal (attached) and SOC2 summary after this email.
- Rishi to run a 60-min technical session with your engineering team next week (optional on-site if preferred).
- Neha to pair with AuroraMed SecOps for any clarifying questions on KMS/HSM and network controls.

Attachments: redwood-initial-proposal.pdf, SOC2_Summary.pdf

Proposed meeting times (Pacific):
- Wed Apr 6, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 7, 08:00–09:00 PT
- Fri Apr 8, 13:00–14:00 PT

Thanks — please let me know which slot works and if you want me to loop Procurement/Law directly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
